name: Maple syrupUSDG
oneLiner: syrupUSDG is Maple's USDG-denominated lending share; credit and strategy returns accrue to NAV, with exits served through a liquidity-dependent FIFO queue.
collateral: Proportional claim on Maple USDG Segregated Portfolio 1, comprising institutional loans and supporting yield strategies, denominated in USDG
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 share NAV reflects USDG-denominated pool assets, accrued interest and impairments. FIFO withdrawals are serviced as liquidity becomes available; there is no guaranteed maximum withdrawal period.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum MaplePool 0x87b65c4aaffa76881f9e96f3e7ed945ddfc3cd7a is a USDG-denominated pooled-credit share, not a one-to-one USDG reserve claim. Maple names Maple International Operations SPC acting for Maple USDG Segregated Portfolio 1 and limits lender recourse to that ring-fenced portfolio. Institutional loans and supporting futures-basis/DeFi strategies earn yield and share pro-rata impairment/default losses. At block 26107703, asset() was USDG, decimals() was 6, totalSupply() was 188334976.708895 shares and totalAssets() was 190837163.740225 USDG. The rwa-credit-fund override mirrors syrupUSDC's credit claim rather than the fiat-cash parent.
